PROP-57888860-pre-005.text: At least one cell must be present for recovery; construct_vanishing_polynomial fails on all-missing input.
PROP-57888860-pre-005.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices): len(cell_indices) > 0 AND len(cell_indices) <= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

locations.note: Input validation delegated to c-kzg-4844 library; Grandine wrapper passes through cell_indices without explicit length check before FFI call
